method: Use33 selected short cues from43 official German publisher caption entries, preserving text and timing. Two official Goethe PDF transcripts confirm scene dialogue and speaker roles; source frames confirm context. No full ASR, extra download, invented speech or guessed word timing.

decisions.reason: Three simple publisher captions teach name, formal address and being new. Intro roles are Nevin and a generic woman; the PDF main-scene transcript begins later.
The early Junge Frau/aussteigen line is repeated in the main scene; the later official cue is retained.
Longer indirect destination clause is unnecessary for this selected A1–A2 practice set.
Ähm and Ja ja add little to the selected practice set.
Official VTT divides Nein / Noch nicht; PDF gives the same speaker turn. Start of18 and end of19 retained; no word timing inferred.
Nummer eins repeats the immediately previous instruction; Auf die Eins drücken retained.
Avoid presenting isolated currency-counting numbers as a complete dialogue turn.
PDF farewell includes auf in the first speaker turn and omits it in Nevin's reply; VTT has the reverse. Lesson follows exact VTT and its timing, without mixing versions.
Same older-woman sentence spans two consecutive publisher cues. Preserve first start and last end.
Both PDFs mark a scene break without new spoken transcript here; source frames show nonverbal/recollection sequence. Do not invent captions or timings.
Ah and second Junge Frau are not needed for practice; first main-scene call retained.
All have publisher timecodes and PDF agreement; final Vielen, vielen Dank is at7:10–7:12, after alighting.
Selected German cues contain at most9 space-delimited words; each part has7 Vietnamese situational prompts and source-linked vocabulary.
